hints.title: Element Occurrence Invariant
hints.text: An element belongs in the intersection of all arrays if and only if it appears in every single array.

hints.title: Frequency Counter
hints.text: Since elements within each individual array are distinct, an element is present in all arrays when its global frequency equals len(nums).

hints.title: Sorted Result
hints.text: Filter all elements with count == len(nums) and sort them in ascending order.

hints.title: Frequency Intersection Implementation

variables: N: total number of elements across all arrays
complexity.notes: Frequency tally in linear time followed by sorting intersection.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated set intersections with copy overhead take more time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tallies occurrences and filters by total array count.
